first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The dark gray-black handgun in the lower right of the first-person view, with a relatively squared-off upper outline and the lower part of the gun body cut off by the edge of the frame.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The older man facing the camera, with gray-white hair puffed out toward both sides and a gray-white mustache on his upper lip, wearing a long white coat, a blue shirt, a red-and-blue tie, and khaki pants.

entities.name: riveted metal wall panel
entities.identification: The large light gray to blue-gray wall panels behind Person A and on both sides of the frame, with seams along the panel edges and rows of dark-colored rivets.

entities.name: metal floor
entities.identification: The extremely small patch of gray-brown floor area visible near the base of the wall along the bottom edge of the frame.

entities.name: dark-colored metal ceiling
entities.identification: The portion of the dark gray ceiling along the top edge of the frame, with layered trim visible along the top of the wall.
